_comment: These overrides are SECURITY FLOORS for transitive dependencies. Each value must be at or above the advisory's patched version — a floor below it silently stops enforcing anything, because >= permits an upgrade without compelling one. That is exactly how fast-uri, @hono/node-server and postcss stayed vulnerable here while an override for each was already present. When you clear an advisory, raise the floor to the patched version rather than relying on a re-resolve.
